_: Controls that moved during the redesign. A control may move; it may not vanish. `surface` and `control` must match what parity.mjs prints, `to` says where the capability lives now, and `reason` says why the move is an improvement. An entry here is a claim a reviewer can check against the after-screenshots.

moved.to: the same column heading, as BaseTable's sort button
moved.reason: The page's own sort control, moved onto BaseTable's. Same action, same place, same state (`getSortedCannedResponses`), but it gains aria-sort, an accessible name from TABLE.SORT_BY and the shared chevron triplet in place of the woot sort icons — so its identity in the inventory changes from its inner text to its label. It is reported as added on the same capture: "Sort by Short code".
